spots.text: A note on the writing slope: The lake is not deep. It is exactly as deep as the room above it. I have measured.

secrets.name: Under the Causeway
secrets.text: The door in the reflection is real. Inside the causeway, at the level of the glass, a long low dry room: a mattress, a candle, a pane of black mirror in the ceiling looking up at nothing.

meta.label: The Mirror Lake
meta.blurb: The floor is a black mirror a man's height down, and the whole hall stands on its own reflection. The causeways are the only thing holding you up. They are enough. Probably.
